summary: Repaired CLI compatibility, runtime packaging, answer-bank shortcuts and semantic deduplication. Verified 10 source banks, 455 native grading responses, delivery filtering and four UI renders. No publication or database changes.

Known source ambiguity is preserved in audit replay; normal sampling uses repaired banks.
